What is Capitalism, and how does it actually work? Is greed really good for the economy?
Adam Smith, often called the father of Capitalism, believed that people working for their own benefit could also end up benefiting society. But his ideas were not as simple as "greed is good". In his famous book The Wealth of Nations, Smith explained how markets, competition, prices and profits shape an economy. He also warned against monopolies, powerful businessmen influencing governments, and companies putting their own interests above the public.
